blocks.text:
Enjoy free days on the coast with all-inclusive accommodation at the hotel.

After Rio and Iguazu, the itinerary leaves several days open. You can spend time by the water, go swimming, relax on the beach or take a boat trip.

Angra is surrounded by islands and small bays. Among them are the famous boot islands, a pair of distinctively shaped rocks. Another option is a trip to Ilha Grande. The island has no car traffic, and walking trails lead to beaches including Lopes Mendes.

You can set your own pace on this part of the trip. Stay at the all-inclusive hotel, spend the day by the water and return to the same beach, or head out into the bay to explore new coves, dive or fish. The calm waters of the sheltered coves feel quite different from Rio’s open beaches.

These days on the coast round off a busy first week. After Carnival’s noise, lights and late nights and Iguazu’s long national park walks close to the thundering falls, the bays of Angra dos Reis offer a slower pace.

Stay at the hotel and beach or choose a different outing on the water each day. Around Angra you’ll find small islands, protected shores, clear bays and old forts. A trip to Ilha Grande takes you to more secluded spots, and a boat trip reveals parts of the coast you can’t see from the road.
